name: Alliance Solutions
about: Alliance Solutions is an industrial supplies company based in Rawalpindi, Pakistan, serving plants, workshops and projects nationwide. From bulk chemicals and protective coatings to fasteners, stainless steel and laboratory instruments, we keep production running with documented grades, honest lead times and a team that answers when you call.
story: Alliance Solutions was built around a simple idea: industrial buyers deserve a supplier who picks up the phone, quotes clearly and delivers exactly what the purchase order says. From our office at Rania Mall, Bank Road, Rawalpindi, we supply everything from solvents and coatings to fasteners, steels, rubber and process instrumentation.

We keep the catalog deep — 1,500+ lines across sixteen categories — so our clients can consolidate purchasing with one dependable vendor instead of chasing a dozen. Every chemical ships with grade documentation, every fastener with the right specification, and every quote with a lead time we actually keep.
mission: To make industrial procurement effortless for Pakistani businesses — certified materials, transparent pricing and dependable delivery from a single, accountable partner.
vision: To become the most trusted industrial supply house in Pakistan, known for the same reliability on order number 5,000 as on order number one.
